note: Gamification system (owner decision D18, 2026-10-20). XP and ranks are for motivation only: never part of the score, the pass mark or the LMS record. No timers, no leaderboards, no penalties.

01.hook: Can you keep your clinic safe in your first week?

02.hook: Can you handle a day in the safety lab?

03.hook: Can you find your way through your first 90 days?

04.hook: Can you get every patient to the right team, first time?

05.hook: Can you write a note that gets the claim paid?

06.hook: Can you turn a rejected claim into a paid one?

07.hook: Can you stop harm before it reaches a patient?

08.hook: Can you close a consultation without a single gap?
